rule: Strongest-model rule (Adam, 20 Oct): BEST is the strongest model we have; a model that is stronger overall replaces it. The test rule stays the evidence: front by front against BEST, 2 standard errors, two seeds when a choice is close; a candidate with no front lost and at least one won is adopted automatically by the loop, a mixed result is decided by Adam. BASE = the recipe new runs build on.

how_gains_are_kept: Every candidate retrains the one chat stage from the same 5M core with BASE plus its changes; an adopted change is written into BASE, so later runs carry it. New abilities are --parts switches that leave older recipes byte-identical (checked on 320 windows per change) and each has its own held-out test before training.

findings_20oct.what: what the search puts in the block limits what the model can combine
findings_20oct.evidence: told fact + stored fact: the stored fact was never retrieved (0/48) because the question lacks its words; two questions in one message: both stored facts in the block 0/12 (one query for the whole message). hop2 and split fix retrieval (41/48, 10/12); the untrained model then answers 9/48 and ~1 part of 2, so training must follow

findings_20oct.what: memory facts were always told one per message and asked one per message
findings_20oct.evidence: audit: skills told turns 0% multi-fact, any-length asking messages 0% multi-question; real dialogues 14% multi-question but only as general chat; real-phrasing 'multipart' test 0/5

findings_20oct.what: the refusal chain is small in general
findings_20oct.evidence: answers directly after a correct refusal 300/320 vs 307/320 with no refusal; Adam's case ('brother's name' -> '12 plus 30' refused) is a rarer pattern on seed 2

findings_20oct.what: the 5M learns its training patterns but not new wordings
findings_20oct.evidence: skills held-out windows 92% in training vs 39% on the suite's held-out wordings; clarify 0% despite 10,410 training examples; the case for the 100M
